question: Qual foi o total faturado em pagamentos por boleto bancário por estado do comprador em pedidos entregues?
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    c.customer_state, 
    ROUND(SUM(op.payment_value), 2) AS boleto_revenue 
FROM marts.fct_order_payments op 
JOIN marts.fct_orders o 
    ON op.order_id = o.order_id 
JOIN marts.dim_customers c 
    ON o.customer_unique_id = c.customer_unique_id 
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' 
  AND op.payment_type = 'boleto' 
GROUP BY c.customer_state 
ORDER BY boleto_revenue DESC 
LIMIT 5;
